import "join"
import "array"

// Step 1: Define a dummy table to prevent empty `ints`
dummyInts = array.from(rows: [{interface: "DUMMY"}])

// Step 2: Identify interfaces currently matching the operSt filter
ints = from(bucket: "cisco_mdt")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "sys/intf")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["switch"] == "${Switch}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["type"] =~ /${interfaceType:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "operSt")
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_time", "_value", "interface"])
  |> last()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_value"] =~ /${operSt:regex}/)
  |> keep(columns: ["interface"])
  |> group()

// Step 3: Ensure `ints` is never empty by unioning with `dummyInts`
ints2 = union(tables: [ints, dummyInts])

// Step 4: Get full historical operational state data
data = from(bucket: "cisco_mdt")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "sys/intf")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["switch"] == "${Switch}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["type"] =~ /${interfaceType:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "operSt")
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_time", "_value", "interface"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${Interval}, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> group()

// Step 5: Perform an inner join using your original working syntax
result = join.inner(
  left: data,
  right: ints2,
  on: (l, r) => l.interface == r.interface,
  as: (l, r) => l
)

// Step 6: Remove the dummy row if it exists
result2 = result |> filter(fn: (r) => r.interface != "DUMMY")

// Step 7: Output the final result
result2 |> group(columns: ["interface"]) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "interface"])

base = from(bucket: "cisco_mdt")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "sys/procsys/syscpusummary")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["switch"] == "${Switch}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["procSysCpuSummary/procSysCpu"] == "syscpu-ALL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "avg")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${Interval}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)

idle = base
   |> filter(fn: (r) => r["procSysCpuSummary/procSysCpu/procIdle"] == "idle")
   |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with metric: "idle"}))

irq = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["procSysCpuSummary/procSysCpu/procIrq"] == "irq")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with metric: "irq"}))

kernel = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["procSysCpuSummary/procSysCpu/procKernel"] == "kernel")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with metric: "kernel"}))

nice = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["procSysCpuSummary/procSysCpu/procNice"] == "nice")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with metric: "nice"}))

softirq = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["procSysCpuSummary/procSysCpu/procSoftirq"] == "softirq")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with metric: "softirq"}))

total = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["procSysCpuSummary/procSysCpu/procTotal"] == "total")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with metric: "total"}))

user = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["procSysCpuSummary/procSysCpu/procUser"] == "user")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with metric: "user"}))

wait = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["procSysCpuSummary/procSysCpu/procWait"] == "wait")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with metric: "wait"}))

union(tables: [idle, irq, kernel, nice, softirq, total, user, wait])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "metric"])
  |> group(columns: ["metric"])
